Engineering Principles

Reversibility

Normalise where mistakes are reversible; defer normalisation where they're not. A wrong materialized view is a redefinition away from correction. A wrong schema at ingest is a multi-service migration.

Match storage to question

Recommendations want point lookups; segmentation wants population filtering; reporting wants columnar aggregation. One database cannot efficiently answer all three.

Operational simplicity beats abstractions

Legible systems are easier to debug than clever ones. A Pub/Sub consumer with lag metrics beats a Dataflow job hiding what's happening. When a small team owns it, debuggability under pressure matters most.
